headlines.title: What’s fueling inflation? Fuel.
headlines.description: The final CPI report before the midterms is expected to reflect soaring energy costs compounded by higher airfares, pricier iPhones and rising car prices.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Bank of America ordered to pay historic $1.2 billion over alleged sanctions law violations
headlines.description: The fine is the third-highest penalty ever issued by the Treasury Department, which found that the bank failed to report billions in suspicious transactions.

headlines.title: Diesel futures jump, signaling higher prices to come despite Trump’s Russia deal
headlines.description: “Absolutely stunning price spikes in wholesale diesel today,” a top energy analyst said.

headlines.title: Holiday Budget Tips to Make Sure You Don't Overspend
headlines.description: With the holiday season looming, the most wonderful time of the year can quickly become the most expensive and stressful time of the year. Finance expert and author Jean Chatzky joins TODAY with ways to save on gifts, travel, and more.

headlines.title: How to Save as Temperatures Drop and Heating Costs Rise
headlines.description: Whether you use oil or electricity to heat your home, you may notice a higher heating bill this year. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY with tips on how to prepare your home, ways to keep costs down and resources for financial assistance.

headlines.title: Carhartt CEO weighs in on retail affordability
headlines.description: The demand for skilled trade workers such as electricians, carpenters, and mechanics is expected to accelerate in the next decade and Carhartt, which has long been a staple for those doing these jobs, is seeing changes in the retail landscape. NBC News' Christine Romans spoke with Carhartt CEO Linda Hubbard about what the company is seeing as affordability remains top of mind for Americans.

headlines.title: Financial Tips to Support Your Kids and Your Aging Parents
headlines.description: The sandwich generation is that expensive time when you’re raising kids and helping out aging parents. NBC’s Christine Romans joins TODAY with tips to navigate that financial situation and resources that can help.

headlines.title: To counteract a spooky economy, America prepares to spend on Halloween candy
headlines.description: This Halloween, rising prices for groceries and gas are pushing many consumers to cut back. But they’re not giving up Halloween candy.

headlines.title: Energy prices rise after Trump’s ‘energy ceasefire’ fails to move Russia or Ukraine
headlines.description: Oil and gas prices rose Monday after an “energy ceasefire” announced by President Donald Trump on Sunday failed to gain traction.

headlines.title: Starbucks is ‘not buying Chipotle’ after report it had explored a deal
headlines.description: The coffee giant had reportedly hired advisers to work on a Chipotle takeover proposal.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.
